identity.real_world_identity_notes: Mitsubishi Lancer prepared for the Brazilian Lancer Cup in R specification, built from the Lancer Evolution X. It ran as a separate class from the sequential RS and was later discontinued.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behaviour was directly observed in a guided drive in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled. There is no automatic cut or blip, so the driver lifts to upshift and blips to downshift.

The gearbox is synchronised, so a downshift blip is authentic technique and eases the synchros but is not needed to engage the gear. It is recorded as optional rather than required, which is reserved for gearboxes that cannot engage without it.

The R and the RS share the Lancer Cup class and are entirely different to drive: this car is a five-speed H-pattern with no automation, and the RS is a six-speed sequential with an automatic cut. Nothing is inherited between them.
The reviewed reference covers the RS rather than this car, so the R's gearbox construction is the ordinary reading of a road-derived manual rather than a stated specification.
This class reports a single configuration; the selection screen offers no aero package and only the plain identity has been observed.

The earlier record cited a community site generated from Coanda's AMS2 spreadsheet, and read this car's H-pattern as the specification that reference distinguished from the RS. The independent sources describe the R's preparation but not its gearbox, so the H-pattern now rests on the drive alone.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.mitsubishi-lancer-r.20260816t041854279z-f97ce43e by Jason Kinslow.

confidence.basis: Simulator behaviour was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the real-world transmission is supported by registered sources.

claims.basis: A registered reference establishes the Lancer Cup and its two cars, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
